text:
All tests pass (6/6): existing length test and the new pressure tests covering `Pa`, `kPa`, `bar`, `atm`, and the unknown-unit `ValueError`.

Implemented `units/pressure.py::to_pascal(value, unit)` mirroring the existing `units/length.py` pattern (factor table + `KeyError`→`ValueError` translation), with `atm = 101325 Pa` exactly per the workplan. Added `tests/test_pressure.py` covering all four units plus the unknown-unit error. No changes needed elsewhere; existing tests continue to pass.
